title: Ostomy Supply Program Units Covered by a Convex Barrier Liability Notice
content:
For an Ostomy Supply Program liability notice for convex barriers (A4407), the units a notice covers are the order's excess per 30 days (the newest written order's quantity per 30 days less the tier's allowance, never below zero) times one standard supply of 30-day blocks (the tier's standard supply days divided by 30), rounded down to a whole barrier.

## Inputs

- **Newest written order** - the program's written order for the convex barrier with the latest order date, read for its quantity per 30 days.
- **The tier's allowance** - The tier's allowance for the convex barrier is 20 billing units per 30 days on the Ostomy Self-Pay Program, Ostomy Commercial PPO Program, Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program and Ostomy Original Medicare Program, 15 on the Ostomy Commercial HMO Program and 10 on the Ostomy Medicaid Program.
- **One standard supply of 30-day blocks** - the tier's standard supply days per shipment divided by 30.

## Adjustments

Each adjustment to the standard units changes them as that adjustment states: changes to the 30-day blocks and shares added to the excess act before the units are rounded down to a whole barrier, the shares being added into one share applied once, and units deducted come off after the rounding, never below zero.

The units are fixed only on tiers whose notice the customer can sign (the plan member waiver, the CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice or the Medicaid non-covered service agreement). A program without a written order for the convex barrier has no order excess, so no notice units are fixed for it.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Tier allowance | Standard supply | Newest order per 30 days | Excess | Blocks | Units covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | 90 days | 28 | 8 | 3 | 24 |
| 15 | 30 days | 22 | 7 | 1 | 7 |
| 10 | 30 days | 9 | 0 (never below zero) | 1 | 0 |
